data.long_meaning: Mikail is the name of the angel Jibreel (Gabriel) in Arabic. The name Mikail means 'God is He Who honors (makes exalted) and gives power'. In Islamic tradition, Jibreel is the angel who delivers the revelation to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the Night Journey (Isra and Mi'raj). Mikail is also believed to be the guardian of the Throne of Allah, and is mentioned in the Quran as being present during the creation of Adam (AS)
